turns.speaker: volunteer
turns.raw: Hi, is this Rosalind Featherstone? This is Jordan Pike, a volunteer with Brightpath Youth Alliance.

turns.speaker: donor
turns.raw: Yes, speaking. Oh, Brightpath, how nice to hear from you.

turns.speaker: volunteer
turns.raw: I'm calling just to say thank you for your gift to the Spring Youth Appeal. It means a lot to us.

turns.speaker: donor
turns.raw: Well, Walter and I always gave together. My husband passed away in March, so this year it was just me.

turns.speaker: volunteer
turns.raw: I'm so sorry for your loss. Thank you for telling me about him.

turns.speaker: donor
turns.raw: Thank you. I miss him every day. He worked at Larkspur Valley Hospital for thirty years, right here in Millbrook.

turns.speaker: volunteer
turns.raw: That sounds like a wonderful legacy. What did he enjoy most about it?

turns.speaker: donor
turns.raw: The people, mostly. Can I ask, what does the youth program actually do day to day?

turns.speaker: volunteer
turns.raw: Great question. Students meet with a trained mentor every week after school.

turns.speaker: donor
turns.raw: That's lovely. And where does the money go, for the youth program?

turns.speaker: volunteer
turns.raw: I can have the office send you the program summary. What's the best way to reach you?

turns.speaker: donor
turns.raw: Please email me rather than calling. It's rfeatherstone@example.org, or my cell is (814) 555-0142 if it's urgent.

turns.speaker: volunteer
turns.raw: Got it, email it is. Should anything by post go to the house?

turns.speaker: donor
turns.raw: Letters can go to 47 Juniper Hollow Road. Just no phone calls during tax season, please.

turns.speaker: volunteer
turns.raw: Understood. Thank you again, Mrs. Featherstone. The office will email you the program summary next week.
